utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we still on for the repair drive, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, still on — I’m heading out to pick up a few things now. If you can bring gloves and a flashlight, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll bring gloves and a flashlight. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus — I might need a wrench and a screwdriver, if you’ve got ’em.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ve got both. I can bring them by for the repair drive whenever you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — the repair drive. I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’m keeping an ear out and will let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate that. I’m just trying to figure out the timing and who’s handling what.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and see who’s coordinating it and when they’re starting. If I hear anything solid, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you swing by the community shed first and pick up the repair kit? Then bring it over to the front porch when you’re done.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll head to the community shed, grab the repair kit, and bring it to the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m in — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and see who can help out. Want me to invite folks over this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot, Quinn. Afternoon’s good—thank you.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start inviting people now and swing by this afternoon with whoever I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m pulling together the repair drive list now. If you know any homes that need help, send them my way and I’ll add them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I know one house on Maple with a leaking porch and another on 3rd that needs a fence fix.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — I’ll add both to the list and follow up on Maple and 3rd. If you think of any others, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready—what details do we need to confirm for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help. Do we need to confirm the time, the drop-off spot, and what tools or parts people should bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, let’s confirm those three first, and then we can make sure everyone knows what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule — what time works best for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be wonderful, Faye — late Saturday morning works best for me, if that fits the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late Saturday morning should work well for me too. I’ll line it up around the school schedule and confirm the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—folks are dropping off tools and a few neighbors already signed up to help. I can swing by later and fill you in on what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what’s the quickest way I can help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’re actually available this week to help?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’m available this week—just tell me the quickest task.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I think we still need a few tools and a couple folks to help sort donations, but I might be missing something.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds manageable. I can help sort donations if you need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll check our supplies and set aside what we can spare.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep sharing the plan and let people know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, any update on the repair drive? I’m heading out for errands and can spread the word if needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I don’t have a fresh update yet, but I’m still gathering a few details. I’ll let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out. Just send me the update when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m in, I just need the details again so I don’t mix up the time or place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely—I'll send the time and place again so it’s easy to follow. No worries, I’ll make sure you’ve got the right details.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—I appreciate it. I’ll keep an eye out for your message and be there once I’ve got the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What did I miss?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Not much yet — I was just checking who still needs a hand and what parts we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I can help check who still needs a hand. What parts are we short on?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll bring the list, and you bring the tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll bring the tools and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Happy to help with the repair drive, Quinn. What do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Mara — could you help me spread the word and sign people up? I’ll send you the details so you can invite a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — send me the details and I’ll start reaching out to a few neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need from me, Opal?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I need the repair drive location and the best way to get there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s at the community center on Maple, just past the library. Easiest way is to take Oak over and then turn right at the park.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep the repair drive organized and make sure everyone knows where to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Rosa — I’ll keep an eye on our supplies and let you know what we’re running low on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo — I’ll update the list and let folks know what we need next.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is getting moving, but I’m still piecing together the details. Have you heard what they’re fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I haven’t heard the exact order yet. Do you know if they’re starting with roofs or the plumbing?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet — I’ve only heard bits and pieces second-hand. I’ll ask around and see if I can find out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’m in, but I’ll need the quick version of what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — we just need a few hands for the repair drive, mainly to help set up, sort donations, and pack things up after school.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can help with setup and packing after school. Just send me the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you can handle the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can handle the repair drive.
